answer: A practical sybil brake is stake-gated eligibility: before an identity can attest or grade, it must park spendable POA on a bonding ledge for N epochs, reclaimable only after a quiet oasis of continuous clean grades. A farm that mints thousands of aliases pays that bond per head; if any clone fails honeypot checks, the bond burns and the attacker hits a nadir of capital, so fake identities stop being free.
